reviews.x: I was nervous to try this because I suffer from migraines and brushing my hair hurts and is often uncomfortable. I have extremely frizzy hair and I just tried this for the first time. It smoothed my frizz and made my hair shiny. I like it.

This hair brush is cool. After I brush my hair it leaves my hair shinny and manageable. The only thing is it's kinda heavy compared with a normal brush. But it's worth it for a home brush because will treat your hair and even relaxes your scalp.

Very Soothing!  This brush is so relaxing.  Even without turning on the vibration, the stainless steel bristles feel so soothing on my scalp.  I like using it after work to de stress while I watch tv.  The vibrations aren’t crazy strong, just enough to massage and stimulate your scalp.  It’s not heavy and doesn’t tangle in my hair.  Also good to use if you have trouble falling asleep!  After a few minutes of using it I’m ready to doze off zzzzz

I bought this hairbrush because of my 6 year old daughter hates having her hair brushed and raved about the regular brush.  My daughter is using this brush over a week and it's working well, I must say, these brushes are great! Finally, I brushed my little girl's hair without complaints and she had a smile on her face. Totally awesome.

The brush makes my hair softer and shinier. But not a huge difference to be honest.  The massage function I didn't really care for. The vibration is pretty weak so I couldn't feel it even when I pressed the brush against my scalp. But I bought this mainly for the ion function so I don't mind.  The bristles are okay, just like any other brush. Doesn't do a great job of detangling and pulls out some hair. So I use my other detangling brush first then use this one for extra shine and smoothing.  It
This product really helps with the static hair or even jsut anyone that has puffy hair in the morning. The massage portion of the comb is great too and it’s the perfect size!
This is the most absolute amazing hair detangler i have invested in! I'm pretty sure it works well with all hair types. Love it!
Absolutely worthless. The high ratings gave me hope, but no, this is no better than a regular brush.

I have fine hair that gets staticky or frizzy very easily, depending on the weather, and it tends to look unbrushed shortly after I’ve brushed it. With all the hype, I hoped this brush would be the answer, but it hasn’t been. My hair looks just as bad after I’ve used it as it did before I used it. I have wavy hair that is frizz-prone - the supposed hair type this product is perfect for.  This brush does NOT do what it claims.  No enhanced smoothing, straightening, or de-frizzing.  This is a glorified travel brush.  Just an ordinary brush with pie-in-the-sky claims.  Very disappointing.
Terrible brush, it didn’t do what it said it would. I don’t recommend it
It doesn't do anything it says fir your hair dont waste your money

reviews.t: Does not work on new growth
reviews.x: Even though this doesn't help with my frizzy new growth baby hairs I still love it. It makes my hair extremely soft, Eliminates frizz, and makes my hair straighter. I AM white with super frizzy Irish hair. I definitely saw a difference while using this brush. Also seems to not use much battery life. So far I have been using it for 6 months on the same batteries I first put in. My biggest complaint is that mine arrived damaged. The brush is removable for easy clean(which I love) but the lock to k

reviews.t: So sad it does nothing a normal cheaper brush wouldn’t do
reviews.x: Oh no! I had such high expectations for this to help my daughter with her tangles. It is nothing more than a brush that waste batteries. It did nothing for frizz with the ionizer, it did nothing for the tangle with the vibration. There is a light on top of the brush and the sound of vibration but nothing really happens except noise. I guess you could say it did something if you took way too long to brush through a small section of hair. Which I think if you took extra time with a regular brush i

This little device really does make a difference in static and frizz and leaves my hair smoother, softer, and shinier! I was pleasantly surprised at how much it helped! The vibrate/massage function is pretty useless, but I didn't buy it for that anyway, just the ionic part, and that does what it says it will! Very pleased and will continue to use this! I can also see how easy it would be to bring this with me for touch ups!

This comb does not reduce frizz. It seems to be a normal brush that just makes static noise. The vibration/massage setting causes the handle to vibrate more than the bristles. I may have been sent a defective brush,  but it seems the other reviews that describe the same experience as mine indicates that this is a scam product. Hopefully I can return this, and use the money towards  a higher quality version.

reviews.t: The Product Works Great, But Beware of Possible Reviews Manipulation
reviews.x: For me, this works great. It does smooth my frizzy hair and gives a great massage. It looks very well designed too. I'm surprise at why would the seller incentivized reviews anyways.  Beware of review manipulation. Inside the packaging, there is an insert that says you can get a free product if you send a screenshot of your review.

reviews.t: If only ZERO stars were possible...
reviews.x: This was a total waste of money. I tried it for a week and saw no difference in my hair. Also, the vibrations affected my palm more than my scalp. When I had the vibrate feature turned on, the bristles did nothing. Instead the top of the brush vibrated. I returned this and got my money back.

reviews.t: Didn't work for my long curly hair.
reviews.x: Didn't work for me. I have long curly hair and live in Florida where humidity is always high. It made the frizzy worse for my hair. I gave it to my mom who had wavy hair and it made her hair frizzy. I don't know if the humidity made it worse but the product didn't benefit me at all.

reviews.t: It definitely doesn't work.  I will return it.  I do not recommend it .
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:e09e2a2226ee98365430cc7c2a95bc1a]] The product does not work just makes an annoying noise and in the first function does not work.  and in the second one it's just a sound but I don't notice any difference in my hair.

reviews.t: Works really well - I LOVE IT
reviews.x: If used as directed this product works great to keep static fly-aways down to a minimum.  I was having allot of static in my hair and this has helped tremendously.  Plus the massage option feels great on the scalp.
I have thin coarse hair, very difficult to manage. This brush saves so much time and works amazing. This is portable, does not take much space in my purse. Very happy with the purchase.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the brush smooths frizz and leaves hair shiny and manageable.
Several reviewers find the brush soothing and relaxing for the scalp, though some say the vibration is weak or worthless.
A number of reviewers say the brush does nothing and is no better than a regular brush, especially for frizz-prone or fine hair.
Some reviewers report it helps detangle hair, including for a child who dislikes brushing.
One reviewer notes the brush is somewhat heavy compared with a normal brush.
